items.prompt: The only bid level has quantity 5 at 1000 cents. A valid cancel removes 2. What happens to that bid quote?

options.text: It vanishes because every cancel removes an entire price.
options.why: This is a quantity delta, not a whole-level deletion command.
Quantity changes do not rewrite the price.

options.text: It prints a missing-side marker until another add.
options.why: There are still three resting units after this partial cancel.
Only a level whose remaining total reaches zero is removed.

items.explanation: Only a level whose remaining total reaches zero is removed.
